items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: That was with Herbie Haymer, Arnold Ross, Les Paul, Shadow Wilson.

ctx.x: Maybe you could get some kind of deal to get it released here. It's a shame that we don't get all the breaks they get there, that there's music we don't get to hear.

Yeah. I wouldn't know how... I'd have to check on that. But I see one thing here that I remember very well that was interesting, the Red Callender Six. On that one I had Harry Edison, Herbie Haymer (remember him?)...,
